cases.letter:
Willowbrook Health Plan — Pharmacy Services
Date of notice: September 15, 2026

RE: Coverage determination for estradiol transdermal patch 0.05 mg/day

Dear Member,

We reviewed the prior authorization request submitted by your prescriber for the medication listed above. This request has been denied.

Reason for decision: Your plan requires step therapy for this medication. Coverage criteria require a documented trial of a preferred alternative (oral estradiol tablets) for at least 30 days, or documentation of medical necessity explaining why the preferred alternative is not appropriate. We did not find this documentation in the request.

Your rights: You or your prescriber may file an appeal within 60 calendar days of the date of this notice. If you believe waiting could seriously jeopardize your health, you may request an expedited appeal.

Questions? Call Member Services at 1-800-555-0142 (TTY 711), Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–8 p.m.
cases.notes: Standard step therapy denial with 60-day appeal window.

cases.letter:
Brightline Rx Benefits
Notice date: October 1, 2026

Medication requested: fezolinetant (Veozah) 45 mg tablet

This medication is non-formulary under your current plan and is not covered.

Your prescriber may submit a formulary exception request. The request must include a statement of medical necessity indicating that covered formulary alternatives have been ineffective, not tolerated, or are clinically inappropriate for you.

Covered alternatives for your condition may include medications listed on Tier 2 of your formulary. Please discuss options with your prescriber.

A formulary exception request may be submitted at any time. If an exception is denied, you may appeal within 65 days of that decision, and you may be eligible for independent review.

Contact: 1-888-555-0199
cases.notes: No deadline for the exception request itself. Model should not invent one.
